subject: Re: AWS Marketplace usage hook retrofit & DocuSign for SaaS fulfillment
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmesoft.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmesoft.com, finance@acmesoft.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Info needed — migrating Acme's legacy metering to AWS Marketplace

Hi Mateo,

We spoke briefly last week about moving Acme's subscription/usage billing for Analytics+ from our internal metering pipeline to AWS Marketplace SaaS metering. Before we kick off legal/procurement, procurement asked for a clear plan and a mapping of the legacy usage records to Marketplace dimensions and the webhook contract you require.

Specifically:
- Can Redwood receive and validate a POST from our usage collector (JSON schema)?
- Do you require signed DocuSign annex for the fulfillment contract?
- Any delay or blackout windows for cutover we should be aware of?

Lisa (cc'd procurement and finance) — would prefer a week-long window for testing + one production cutover.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Billing Ops — Acme Soft
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmesoft.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Info needed — migrating Acme's legacy metering to AWS Marketplace

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear checklist. High level answers up front, then an implementation plan attached.

Short answers:
- Yes — Redwood supports inbound usage POSTs (JSON) to the Marketplace usage hook. We validate on receipt and emit a 200/422 pattern we document.
- DocuSign: we require a signed fulfillment annex for Marketplace entitlements; we can bundle it together with the SaaS contract (we've attached the annex .pdf).
- Cutover: target 48-hour staging window plus a 24-hour production observation window; we'll keep a soft fallback to legacy for 72 hours.

Attached: Redwood_AWS_Fulfillment_Spec_v1.3.pdf — includes example payloads, error codes, required headers (x-marketplace-signature), and replay protection guidance. Also attached a mapping workbook (Acme_Legacy_To_Marketplace_Mapping.xlsx) shaped with your sample records.

Next steps I propose:
1) Tech sync (30 min) this Thursday 10am PT to confirm payload fields and test endpoint.
2) We open the AWS support case and coordinate with Partner Support for entitlement provisioning.
3) Legal: we'll send the DocuSign link for the annex once procurement confirms the SOW values.

Ben will run the tech call; Karthik will confirm entitlement naming and SKU mapping for the Marketplace listing. Kimberly — can you confirm our standard blackout window for major customers?

- Mateo
Senior Partner Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_AWS_Fulfillment_Spec_v1.3.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: Acme_Legacy_To_Marketplace_Mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: lisa.tran@acmesoft.com
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:59:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: tech sync agenda + test plan

Hi Lisa — looking forward to the call. Quick answers to a few technical points you raised:

- Payload: send usage deltas per customer per dimension. We recommend batching up to 1,000 events per POST. Example in the spec under /examples.
- Auth: we support an HMAC header; we also accept AWS-signed requests if you want to keep it inside your infra.
- Idempotency: include client_message_id for each batch to avoid double-counts; we will return a receipt_id.

On the call we'll step through the mapping workbook. Can you confirm who will provision test API credentials on your side?

Also looping in AWS Partner Support (marketplace-supp@amazon.com) to pre-warm the entitlement provisioning track — we'll open the case after the call.

Cheers,
Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood
From: procurement@acmesoft.com <procurement@acmesoft.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lisa.tran@acmesoft.com, finance@acmesoft.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DocuSign timing and pricing annex

Mateo / Ben — procurement reviewed the annex and we have two operational questions from finance:
1) How will prorations be handled in Marketplace for mid-billing-cycle upgrades?
2) We need the expected invoice flow (Acme receives a single monthly invoice from AWS or split?) and the timing of chargebacks to us.

If there's a short FAQ we can share with our finance team that maps Redwood pricing -> Marketplace billing artifacts, that would help.

Thanks,
Acme Procurement
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acmesoft.com, lisa.tran@acmesoft.com
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DocuSign timing and pricing annex

Hi Acme team — quick answers for procurement/finance: 

1) Prorations: Marketplace handles prorations at the entitlement level; for usage-based tiers we recommend reconciliation windows where Redwood issues an adjustment event within the same billing period. We'll include example journal entries in the FAQ.
2) Invoice flow: AWS issues a consolidated invoice to Acme for Marketplace charges. If you want Redwood to invoice Acme directly for non-Marketplace line items we can still do that, but marketplace-metered charges will appear on AWS's invoice.

I'm attaching a short FAQ here (see Drive link in related_links) and will add a one-page mapping that finance can use.

Procurement — if that answers the high-level ask, Mateo will send the DocuSign envelope by EOD Monday once you confirm contract values.

- Karthik
Head of Marketplace Integrations, Redwood Inference
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acmesoft.com, lisa.tran@acmesoft.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marketplace-supp@amazon.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: DocuSign envelope + cutover plan

Thanks everyone. Procurement confirmed the SOW values earlier today — attaching the DocuSign envelope link for the SaaS fulfillment annex: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D

Cutover plan (summary):
- Tue 2027-05-25: Sandbox integration test window. Acme sends test batches to our sandbox hook; Redwood validates and returns receipts.
- Thu 2027-05-27 02:00-08:00 PT: Production cutover window. We'll switch Marketplace usage ingestion from legacy collector to the Marketplace hook.
- Fri 2027-05-28: Observation window; automatic fallback to legacy for 72 hours if we detect >0.5% discrepancy on rolling 1-hour windows.

Please sign the DocuSign by EOD Monday 2027-05-24 so we can request entitlements from AWS Partner Support and provision SKUs. AWS Support Case AWS-123456789 is open and Partner Support is looped for entitlement provisioning.

Attachments: SaaS_Marketplace_Annex_DocuSign.pdf (for reference).

Mateo
